title: Engineering work habits
introduction: Build a repeatable process for framing, estimating, checking, and documenting engineering work. Use original worked examples and a saved portfolio of fresh practical tasks. Completion is self-checked, with assistance labeled separately. Independent human review is pending.

modules.title: From problem frame to reproducible record

lessons.title: Frame the problem and make a useful sketch
lessons.objective: Create a labeled sketch or equivalent text diagram, define the system boundary and unknown, and separate supplied facts from modeling assumptions.

lessons.title: Estimate first and carry units through the model
lessons.objective: Record a rough prediction before detailed calculation, use a dimensionally consistent relationship, and explain how one uncertain input changes the result.

lessons.title: Check reasonableness and model limits
lessons.objective: Audit a result with independent checks of dimensions, sign, scale and limiting behavior, identify the first unsupported step, and explain what remains uncertain.

lessons.title: Revise and leave a reproducible work record
lessons.objective: Preserve an initial attempt, document a specific evidence-based revision, and produce a concise final record with inputs, method, result, checks and next action.
